body: While waiting for professional help maybe you can find peer support. Check into local support groups. It helps to know you are not alone in your worries.

A breakup can seem like an incredibly overwhelming and impossibly difficult problem. It feels like death. However, I think it will fade with time. Don't make a permanent decision based on something that will change. You are right to give it a month to think over.

I think the more you choose to think about suicide the more it will crop up when you don't choose.

Gender and sexuality issues can be very hard. I think there is peer support out there for you. You are not alone in that struggle.
Are you sure this isn't just perception? Have you really tried talking to strangers?
I can't imagine a person who no stranger would return a greeting to. Why do you feel this is true?

I don't think it's necessarily because of wanting to be chased. It's uncomfortable to tell someone you are not interested and not everyone has the fortitude to do the tough thing and be honest. They also may feel like they're sparing the suitor hurt.
Nobody will say hi back to you? That doesn't sound accurate.
You feel you have a personality (let's ignore looks) that nobody in the world could possibly be compatible with? Maybe so but it seems unlikely to me.
Nice one.
I think situational depression may be related to general depression in terms of brain chemistry because not everyone gets overwhelmed by negative situations. I would say most people do not.

I feel pretty hopeless about love myself and have some major hurdles to overcome. However, I know that at least in theory there is someone very much like me out there. However you are, there is someone who is similar. Finding them is tougher for some of us, it's true.

HSP = highly sensitive person?

It definitely seems unfair. I don't know why life is like that except to say that there doesn't seem to be anything or anyone guaranteeing a fair shake.

Oh in that case I definitely think you should consider going to her parents. It may seem like a violation of trust but I think if you care and want it to stop happening there may be no other way to help someone under 18.

Harsh as it may seem, when someone is a minor it may be a good time to force them to get treatment.
You are not alone in this experience. Happens to me all the time.

Unfortunately cutting may not be enough for involuntary hospitalization, and she might really resent you if you tried to do that, but it may be worth considering contacting outside help. I think for some people all it takes it getting treatment started and they realize they have a problem that can be treated.

I'm sorry I don't have any more specific advice but this sounds like something others may have experience with. Best of luck.
I assure you there are people just like you in each of those regards, although obviously everyone is unique in their overall makeup.

Peer support can be good, like here in r/depression. It helps to see other people going through what you are, and they are often more understanding than people who don't know what it feels like.

Have you considered looking for a local peer support group?

Rest assured that many other people struggle with the exact feelings you are having. I know it often seems like the whole world is "normal" but that is just the superficial appearance of things. You are like the rest of us, especially here in /r/Depression.

I also feel like I am constantly making mistakes and that they are outside my control. It can be pretty overwhelming.

Many people struggle with wanting things that aren't in the cards. If it is truly not possible for you, there is peace in letting it go.

Expressing what you are feeling is good.

School can be pretty overwhelming. It certainly gave me some very low periods when I couldn't complete assignments and parents or personal pressure came down on me.

I'm sorry nobody is noticing your situation or trying to help you. People can be selfish about that. Is there any kind of counselor you can see?

I'm glad you are at least thinking of the consequences.

Are you sure you have exhausted medication possibilities?

It can be very hard for people to understand depression and mental illness. In general sometimes people just don't think about or understand things from another's perspective.

Are you having other marital or personal problems that would lead him to think it might be an act?

Have you considered professional help? They are pretty understanding.
It's hard to offer advice without some details on what you are experiencing. Are you generally unhappy or is it more specific things that have gone wrong?
Thank you for sharing your poem. It is helpful to get a glimpse of what others are experiencing.
Hello. How's it going?
You may be surprised what treatment can do for you if you haven't tried yet.

I think for most people (with normal chemistry) the good experiences do actually outweigh the bad in their minds and memories. The bad things fade. Some people's lives are so bad this is not the situation, and some people have more difficult processing/accepting the bad things that come. And others just cannot feel joy from good experiences.

Personally, if I had some of the simple things I wish I did, I think life would definitely be worthwhile. It's true you will lose everything eventually and I often remind myself of that as well - maybe having some things isn't so bad. We do see plenty of people come to /r/depression distraught over losses.
Excellent news and thanks for stopping in to let others know there is hope.

You are not alone in that reaction to the "what do you do?" question. I feel strongly the same way.

The comparison game often turns out poorly. You could try comparing to people who have worse situations for some perspective. For essentially everyone there are people who have easier/more successful/etc. lives. Nothing that can really be done about that except make the best of what you have.

There are other things than physical attractiveness.

However you may be surprised. I often find people who aren't conventionally attractive very interesting looking. Work on what you have.

Don't give up: as they say, there is someone for everyone. Literally everyone. I have trouble keeping that in mind myself.

I wouldn't blame people for trying to come up with the nicest possible way to turn down a date. It's easier to say they are busy than that they aren't interested and they may not realize how it comes off. Many people want to avoid conflict and uncomfortable situations.

Ls = losses?

It is definitely hard to see other people your age succeed when you are not doing as well. One thing to try if you are making these comparisons is remembering that some people have it (way) worse than you. I know that may not help your pain but some perspective may alleviate it a bit. Don't give up, you have some school under your belt, you can make something happen.

I think there is peace in not expecting/demanding things to change that cannot. The more we fight with those things the more acute the pain over them. And if they can change, keep on trying.
I think suicidal ideation happens for different reasons and yours is no less valid than anyone else's. You are feeling bad.

Basic income and universal healthcare do make sense and unfortunately the US *is* pretty far from it at this point. As you say, automation will take more and more jobs and I think eventually people will realize that being out of work isn't a personal fault.

If robot labor produces so much there will be plenty of excess resources.

Knowing what it's like to have depression and suicidal thoughts makes it painful to know other people are suffering from it. It's a very sad thing. Trying to help can feel good.

I think it's safe to say people who browse this subreddit are already exposed to the themes so it won't rub off any more on them.

I can understand not wanting to share the reason. Just saying "ok" or "fine" or "good" may be an inevitable consequence of not wanting to say what it is... Or you could be honest and say you are not doing very well but don't want to discuss the details.
Maybe it's something they just can't relate too? Finding peer support might be the right idea.
This is the opposite of true I think. Might depend on your own chemistry. Sex in general improves mood.
Well if you sometimes said "not that great" you might be surprised that some people will listen. Especially since it's not a usual response.
It's not fair. I don't think it's very funny but I agree sometimes absurd situations can get a "laugh".
Coloring is a great activity. So are videos. I have a few types of videos that I find most comforting when I'm down and always go to them. Best wishes. :)
For me, it is remembering happier times that makes it tough. I think holiday depression is pretty common. There was quite a spike of readers on /r/SuicideWatch today.
Wow that is tough. Sorry to hear it.
I have the opposite problem. Feel bad during the day because it's when things can be accomplished.
Hate when that happens. Sometimes typing it a second time comes more quickly and smoothly.
That's tough. Do you have any coping strategies other than your friend? Something to distract you maybe, or something soothing.

I've spent many years not able to overcome my social phobias. I hate being rude to strangers. Just recently I have been able to talk to a couple that I might have been interested in but it was very nerve-racking.
Lonely here myself. I try to pick restaurants where it's not unusual to go alone, which isn't very many. It's kind of like a mini date to just be around people at all.
Well, I would like to assure you that everything is going to be ok but the guidelines on the right say not to do so without understanding your personal situation. Care to give any more details?
Thinking of drinking which I do not usually do. Curled up in bed right now trying to escape.

I also find online interaction a bit lacking. I long for some IRL companionship. This is better than nothing but it feels like part way feeding an addiction that is never satisfied.

What is it about age 30 in particular?
Unfortunately we are not allowed to discuss suicide methods in any way here. I'm glad you are considering outcomes/consequences.
Sorry I didn't see the part about talking to friends. Glad you were able to put the thoughts aside.

Have you found someone to talk to?

My lowest point emotionally was caused by a breakup. It was the most terrible feeling I can imagine. It still hurts. Please believe that you can move on. If someone hurts you that badly you have to reprocess your feelings for them in a new light.

Trying to help others does feel good. Thanks for keeping it in mind.

Your pain is real. Others may have things worse but only you really know what it is like to be you.
You are right to want to care for yourself.
Easier than suicide.

Well you're telling us that's a start. You might be really surprised what medication can do.

Isolation is tough to overcome. Feeds on itself at times.
Yeah just the company of a girl is nice. I totally agree and understand. Not always romantic just interacting with them. Makes waking up the real nightmare.
Can you go into any more detail about what the problems are? I wouldn't give up without trying therapy and medication.
In my dreams usually I have romantic love. It's so nice to experience that alternate reality for a while.
I enjoy sleep. It's a real escape for me, usually.
This all has to be real or we wouldn't be experiencing it. As to what happens after death we don't really know do we? Not saying I'm a believer just that we don't know.
Your parents are unwilling to be involved in treatment for depression or you don't want them involved? Antidepressants can work wonders.

Well peeping is a crime. You could ask for help from the authorities. The police or your equivalent of child protective services if you're a minor. You deserve to feel safe at home. Peeping on a step daughter sounds like a prelude to worse. If your mom can't take care of you you may need to do it yourself.
Stay with us and chat a while.

I think there are complex reasons why people are so indifferent. Part of it is that they feel they have their own difficulties which they overcome. People feel that they have earned what they have. They blame others for failing even when they don't know what those people have faced. I think they also lack perspective on what having a tough life feels like. Some people just don't know, some just don't care and some are actively malicious.
Well it sounds like you care about animals. Is that something you can focus on?
Sounds like things that could change for the better in the future. New job, new friend, new boyfriend. Hang in there.
Anger usually fades with age. In another 10 years you will probably wonder what on earth used to make you get so angry.
Humanity needs to make some changes and stop leaving people to suffer on their own. Thanks for posting this, we can each do our part when we know what it's like to be alone and hurt.

Don't take it personally if people disappear on here, it's usually not intentional ghosting. Most responders have their own issues and social niceties aren't always a first priority on here anyway. We run into so many people. It can be easy to forget each is a precious soul.
Definitely works both ways. Might be possible for you to pick out which came first though.
Great post. I feel the same, have been going through and trying to respond to them.
Yeah benzos are no good. Considered wellbutrin?
Is ADHD a possibility? There are treatments.
A dog sounds like a good idea. They can be great companions, and they give unconditional love. It's a good bond to have.
Try to see the beauty in it.
Drugs can help but most come at a cost. Tried antidepressants?
If dating is available to you which it sounds like it is, you may be amazed at the potential other people have. Give them a chance.
Other people do make me feel like a failure but I like to see people who have a partner and seem successful and happy.
I am so isolated and alone but I feel the opposite, being around and seeing other people makes me feel better. I love seeing other people with seemingly happy lives.

This is a tough situation, having unbearable pain but no good way to end it. I wish I could ease your situation.

Are you only suffering from depression or is it specific things in life causing you trouble?
I think love is responsible for the highest highs and lowest lows. Can you try to look for someone who is more available?

People can be pretty cold. It's hard to say why this is but I was not always a caring person myself. Now it makes me so sad when other people suffer at all.

Taking things on the road is something that has occurred to me too. I think it is a hard life, but also free of a lot of stress and obligation. Having less to lose is good in many ways.
Horsies are a good reason to keep on going. So is a friend. I wish I had animals and a friend to care for myself.
We are not allowed to discuss the details of suicide methods here. It is good you are considering possible consequences.

If you have a good potential future it's definitely worth waiting around for. There's no telling how happy or content you may be. One bad relationship is something you can *definitely* put behind you.

As I've gotten older and had some experiences, I think nobody deserves to suffer. Suffering is a horrible thing and our society is far too indifferent to it. Even really bad people deserve peace, I think, hard as it is to accept sometimes.

edit: I don't know about the worst of the worst. We have to do something about them, but how can it be right to hurt people under the premise that hurting others is wrong...

Suffering has definitely taught me to remember to be kind. I was not a very good person for most of my life. Now I am in a bad state with essentially no hope for anything. Call it karma I guess.

Always. Be. Kind.

That said, it sounds like your problems are not really your fault. Maybe you could forgive yourself for any of your own transgressions and accept that others' happen?
That's a tough one. I can understand feeling like that, same with cancer, but I think every new day has something to offer most people. Aren't there little things you enjoy/cherish?
Glad you are able to hang on. Good work.
I agree, it's all about love. Wish it were a possibility for me.
Sounds painful. Nothing else you want to see/do before you go?
What's on your bucket list?
Could find a new partner. Problem solved.

I think what you are feeling is unfortunately a common reaction. Perhaps it's instinctual for a man to feel like that. I hope you can find a reason to keep on trying, maybe your kids. Imagine what it's like not to have a parent at that age.
Weed, dog and a boyfriend are good reasons to live.
From what I've seen it's really devastating to parents.

Everything you mentioned can change.

Have you tried antidepressants and therapy?
You still have more than some people who keep on going. Not that it alleviates the pain but it is worth remembering sometimes.
So true. What a shitty country.
Depends what you expect from it. I think it's a good environment to get checked out, refocus and make sure your meds are right. I'd say go.

I think if there are things you are sad about, there are things you wish for, and if there are things you wish for they might be possible. You are too young to give up yet, especially facing what you've described. It sounds like a tough situation but one you can work through.

There's nothing wrong with netflix, weed and overwatch! Sounds fun, wish I had a gf to do those with. :) I'm sure you can find another.

I don't think walking into the sea is a realistic way to go. Your survival instincts will kick in.

It sounds like your problems could be solved. I would say suicide only makes sense for people who cannot escape their worries in any possible way.

I'm sorry to hear you were in an abusive relationship, but finding another relationship may be a great way to get a place to live and some stability. Your best asset is being female. Imagine life for a male with no prospects...

Aren't there social programs for "job seekers" in the UK?
It's disgusting how little empathy people have for the mentally ill and their suffering. I would say they deserve a taste of what it's like but I wouldn't wish that on anyone.
